papers.title: Haversine-Based Geographically Weighted Panel Regression of Human Development in Gorontalo (2016–2025)
papers.venue: CAUCHY Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi
papers.abstract: Spatial disparities in human development indicate that socioeconomic factors may influence development outcomes differently across locations. This study aims to analyze spatially varying relationships between the Human Development Index and its key determinants in districts and cities in Gorontalo Province, Indonesia, during the period 2016--2025. The analysis uses balanced panel data and models human development as a function of mean years of schooling, life expectancy at birth, and real per capita expenditure. A geographically weighted panel regression approach is applied, with spatial relationships modeled using great-circle distances and an adaptive kernel weighting scheme, while a fixed-effects panel model serves as the global reference. The results reveal a clear spatial heterogeneity in the effects of the explanatory variables, where education consistently shows the strongest positive influence on human development in all regions, followed by health conditions. Economic expenditure exhibits a weaker and spatially varying effect and is not influential in the provincial capital. These findings underscore the importance of accounting for spatial heterogeneity in regional development analyses and support the formulation of place-based human development policies tailored to local conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人类发展存在的空间差异表明，社会经济因素可能对不同地区的发展结果产生不同的影响。本研究旨在分析2016年至2025年间印度尼西亚戈隆塔洛省各区县人类发展指数与其关键决定因素之间的空间变化关系。研究采用平衡面板数据，将人类发展程度视为平均受教育年限、出生时预期寿命和实际人均支出的函数来进行建模。研究采用了地理加权面板回归方法，通过大圆距离和自适应核加权方案来模拟空间关系，并以固定效应面板模型作为全局参考。研究结果表明，解释变量的影响存在明显的空间异质性：教育在所有地区都对人类发展具有最显著的积极影响，其次是健康状况；经济支出则表现出较弱且具有空间差异性的影响，在省会城市中其影响力尤为有限。这些发现强调了在区域发展分析中考虑空间异质性的重要性，并为制定基于地方条件的个性化人类发展政策提供了支持。。研究方法：回归分析、面板数据、面板回归。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of the Backward-Bending Labor Supply Curve of Older Workers in Taiwan: Long-Term Data Analysis from 1978 to 2023
authors: Hen-Chen, Wen-Chen, Bin-Tzong Liu, Wu, Chie
papers.venue: Advances in Management and Applied Economics
papers.abstract:
This study investigates the existence of a backward-bending labor supply curve among older workers in Taiwan, utilizing an extensive longitudinal dataset spanning 46 years (1978–2023). Employing weekly working hours of individuals aged 65 and above as the primary metric, we construct a quadratic empirical model to capture nonlinear wage effects while controlling for demographic characteristics, household structure, and regional fixed effects. Our primary findings indicate that while a nonlinear relationship is statistically present, the criteria for a theoretically consistent "backward-bending" phenomenon are not met in the main model across the observed period. However, robustness checks utilizing the logarithm of wages reveal a significant backward-bending trend in 43 out of 46 years, suggesting that model specification and wage distribution play a pivotal role in empirical outcomes. These results imply that the labor supply behavior of older workers is highly sensitive to functional forms, highlighting the shifting balance between substitution and income effects in an aging economy.

JEL classification numbers: J14, J22, J31, C21.
Keywords: Older workers, Backward-bending labor supply, Taiwan, Long-term data analysis, Wage elasticity.
papers.summary_zh:
【劳动经济学】本研究利用涵盖46年（1978–2023年）的广泛纵向数据集，探讨了台湾老年工人劳动力供给曲线是否存在向后弯曲的现象。以65岁及以上人群的每周工作时间为主要衡量指标，我们构建了一个二次经验模型，以捕捉工资的非线性效应，并控制了人口统计特征、家庭结构和地区固定效应。主要研究结果表明，尽管统计上存在非线性关系，但在整个观测期内，主要模型并未满足理论上的“向后弯曲”现象所需的条件。然而，通过对工资取对数进行的稳健性检验发现，在46年中有43年的数据呈现出明显的向后弯曲趋势，这表明模型设定和工资分布对实证结果具有重要影响。这些结果表明，老年工人的劳动力供给行为对函数形式非常敏感，凸显了在老龄化经济中替代效应与收入效应之间的平衡关系正在发生变化。

JEL分类编号：J14、J22、J31、C21。
关键词：老年工人、劳动力供给向后弯曲、台湾、长期数据分析、工资弹性。。研究方法：固定效应。

papers.title: A Comparative Study of Dynamic Programming and Reinforcement Learning in Finite Horizon Dynamic Pricing
papers.abstract: This paper provides a systematic comparison between Fitted Dynamic Programming (DP), where demand is estimated from data, and Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods in finite-horizon dynamic pricing problems. We analyze their performance across environments of increasing structural complexity, ranging from a single typology benchmark to multi-typology settings with heterogeneous demand and inter-temporal revenue constraints. Unlike simplified comparisons that restrict DP to low-dimensional settings, we apply dynamic programming in richer, multi-dimensional environments with multiple product types and constraints. We evaluate revenue performance, stability, constraint satisfaction behavior, and computational scaling, highlighting the trade-offs between explicit expectation-based optimization and trajectory-based learning.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文系统地比较了拟合动态规划（Fitted Dynamic Programming, DP）与强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）在有限视界动态定价问题中的应用。拟合动态规划通过数据来估计需求，而强化学习则基于策略的迭代更新来优化定价决策。我们研究了这两种方法在结构复杂性逐渐增加的不同环境中的表现，这些环境涵盖了从单一类型基准场景到具有异质需求和跨期收入约束的多类型场景。与那些将动态规划局限于低维环境的简化比较不同，我们在包含多种产品类型和复杂约束的更复杂多维环境中应用了动态规划方法。我们评估了这两种方法的收入表现、稳定性、约束满足能力以及计算效率，并重点探讨了基于显式期望的优化方法与基于策略学习的优化方法之间的权衡。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: The Revenue Effect of Demand Misspecification in Event Ticket Pricing
papers.abstract: We study a finite-horizon dynamic pricing problem for event tickets with limited inventory and time-varying demand. The central practical difficulty is that the total demand function $L(t)$ is not observed directly and must be estimated from data, while pricing decisions are sensitive to its temporal shape. The paper examines how the accuracy of this estimate affects revenue.   We consider a model in which sales intensity is driven by the total demand $L(t)$, a price-response function $v(p)$, and a time-dependent willingness-to-pay factor $\varphi(t)$. The factor $\varphi(t)$ plays a central role: it captures the increase in customers' willingness to pay as the event date approaches and makes the temporal profile of demand economically important for pricing. Within this framework, the updated numerical study evaluates a benchmark dynamic-programming policy across nine deterministic true-demand scenarios, a collection of feature-aware misspecifications of $L(t)$, and multiple environment regimes induced by $v(p)=e^{-ηp}$, the deadline factor $\varphi(t)$, and inventory level $Q$. The reported summaries are based on stochastic simulation and a ratio-of-means relative-loss metric. The results show that a more accurate representation of the temporal demand profile leads to more effective pricing decisions and higher revenue. Over the full misspecification collection the aggregate relative revenue loss is $0.42\%$, the upper decile exceeds $1\%$, and the most expensive errors are omissions of late-demand components. The average effect is therefore modest but non-negligible, and it becomes stronger when deadline effects are pronounced and inventory is tight.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了一个有限视界的动态定价问题，该问题涉及门票销售、库存限制以及需求量的时变特性。实际操作中的核心难点在于总需求函数$L(t)$无法直接观测，必须通过数据来估算，而定价决策却对这一函数的时间变化特征非常敏感。本文探讨了估算准确度对收入的影响。我们构建了一个模型，其中销售强度受到总需求$L(t)$、价格响应函数$v(p)$以及时间依赖的支付意愿因子$\varphi(t)$的共同影响。因子$\varphi(t)$起着关键作用：它反映了随着活动日期临近顾客支付意愿的增加，使得需求的时间分布特征对定价具有重要的经济意义。在这一框架下，我们通过数值模拟评估了九种确定性真实需求情景下的基准动态规划策略，以及一系列对$L(t)$的错误设定情况。这些错误设定包括对$v(p)$、截止日期因子$\varphi(t)$和库存水平$Q$的不同假设。研究结果基于随机模拟和均值比相对损失指标得出：更准确地描述需求的时间分布能够带来更有效的定价决策和更高的收入。在整个错误设定集合中，总体相对收入损失为$0.42\%$，其中最高损失超过了$1\%$；最严重的错误类型是忽略了后期需求成分。虽然平均影响较为温...。研究方法：随机过程、数值模拟。

papers.title: COVID-19, Teleworking, and the Real Estate Market
papers.venue: Journal of real estate finance and economics
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「房地产金融」领域，主题为：COVID-19, Teleworking, and the Real Estate Market。涉及关键词：Economics、Business。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT ACCOUNTING ISSUES IN ORGANIZATIONS
papers.abstract: The requirement for consistency with the principles of sustainable development is currently considered a priority for organizations. In this regard, the international accounting standards (IFRS-S) put into effect play a decisive role in such accountability, but they do not, perhaps, represent how to organize the accounting of sustainable development results in organizations. The article proposes a system of accounting and accountability for sustainable development results, thanks to which special KPIs are used to assess the progress of sustainable development at the organizational level.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】目前，确保与可持续发展原则保持一致被视为组织的首要任务。在这方面，已实施的国际会计准则（IFRS-S）在推动此类责任机制方面发挥了决定性作用，但这些准则或许并未明确说明如何在组织层面对可持续发展成果进行会计核算。本文提出了一种针对可持续发展成果的会计与责任管理体系，该体系通过运用特定的关键绩效指标（KPI）来评估组织在可持续发展方面的进展。。

papers.title: The Empathy Channel in Fertility -- by Sebastian Galiani, Raul A. Sosa
papers.abstract: Being around babies makes people want babies. We formalize this observation as the empathy channel: exposure to infants in the social environment activates neurobiological mechanisms that increase the desire for parenthood. As children become scarcer, this affective stimulus weakens, further eroding the motivation to have children. We embed the mechanism in a two-group overlapping-generations quantity-quality model. The empathy channel generates a positive externality, since each birth raises others’ desire for children, making the decentralized equilibrium inefficient. We characterize the optimal per-child subsidy and show that the first-order Pigouvian rate substantially overshoots the general-equilibrium optimum. The optimal targeting rule follows a Ramsey-like logic, directing the subsidy at the group with the most externality per fiscal dollar, not the group with the largest externality per child. The calibrated model suggests that the empathy channel can account for 3–33% of the fertility decline, with 13.4% at the baseline. At this baseline, the Pigouvian overshoot is 23–32% and the optimal subsidy raises welfare by 0.22% in consumption-equivalent terms.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】与婴儿接触会让人产生想要孩子的愿望。我们将这一现象称为“共情机制”：在社会环境中接触婴儿会激活某些神经生物学机制，从而增强人们成为父母的愿望。随着儿童数量的减少，这种情感刺激逐渐减弱，进一步削弱了人们生育的动机。我们将这一机制纳入一个包含两组人群、且世代重叠的定量-质量模型中进行分析。共情机制会产生正外部性，因为每个新生儿的诞生都会提高其他人对孩子的需求，从而导致分散决策下的均衡效率低下。我们确定了最优的儿童补贴水平，并发现一阶庇古税（Pigouvian tax）的税率会大幅超过一般均衡下的最优水平。最优的补贴分配规则遵循类似拉姆齐（Ramsey）的逻辑，即将补贴定向给予每单位财政支出所产生的外部性最大的群体，而非每个孩子所产生的外部性最大的群体。根据校准后的模型，共情机制可以解释3%至33%的生育率下降现象；在基准情景下，这一比例约为13.4%。在该基准情景下，庇古税的超额效应为23%至32%，而最优补贴政策可使福利水平提高0.22%（以消费等值单位衡量）。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Profit Regulation and Strategic Transfer Pricing by Vertically Integrated Firms: Evidence from Health Care -- by Pragya Kakani, Eric Yde, Genevieve P. Kanter, Richard G. Frank, Amelia M. Bond
papers.abstract: We provide evidence of strategic transfer pricing by vertically integrated health care firms in response to insurer profit regulations. Insurers increased prices at vertically integrated pharmacies by 9.5% following the introduction of caps on insurer profits in Medicare Part D. We detect larger price increases by insurers that were at greatest risk of exceeding the allowable profit level. More than one-fifth of these higher prices were borne by the federal government. Our analysis illustrates that vertically integrated firms can evade profit regulation by “tunneling” profits to unregulated subsidiaries, undermining regulatory intent and increasing health care spending.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】我们提供了证据，证明垂直整合的医疗保健企业在面对保险公司利润监管时采用了战略性转移定价策略。在医疗保险D部分（Medicare Part D）实施利润上限规定后，保险公司将其在垂直整合药店中的药品价格提高了9.5%。我们发现，那些最有可能超出允许利润水平的保险公司提高了更高的价格。这些价格上涨带来的成本中，有超过五分之一由联邦政府承担。我们的分析表明，垂直整合的企业可以通过将利润“转移”至不受监管的子公司来规避利润监管，从而削弱监管效果，并增加医疗保健支出。。

papers.title: Gender, Unpaid Work, and Social Norms in Young Italian Families: Evidence from Couples Time Diaries
papers.abstract: Why do large gender inequalities in everyday life persist even as women strengthen their attachment to paid work? Existing evidence shows that women continue to do more unpaid work than men, but much of that evidence is based on individual diaries, says little about how inequality is jointly organized within couples, and rarely links daily time allocation to directly measured gender attitudes. This paper addresses that gap using the TIMES Observatory, an original survey of 1,928 co-resident couples with at least one child younger than 11 in Emilia-Romagna or Campania. The data combine matched partner diaries for one weekday and one weekend day with rich socio-economic information and direct measures of gender norms. We document three main findings. First, women do substantially more unpaid work and spend more time with children, while men do more paid work and enjoy more leisure without children. Second, these asymmetries remain sizeable even among dual full-time couples, implying that stronger female labor-market attachment does not by itself equalize daily life. Third, more traditional gender attitudes - especially among men - are descriptively associated with lower male participation in childcare and domestic work and with wider gaps in discretionary leisure. The analysis is descriptive rather than causal, but it shows that gender inequality within couples is visible not only in the amount of work performed, but also in the distribution of time that is genuinely discretionary.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】为什么即使在女性更加重视有偿工作的情况下，日常生活中的性别不平等现象仍然持续存在？现有研究表明，女性仍然比男性承担更多的无偿工作，但这些证据大多基于个人日记记录，对于夫妻之间不平等现象的共性机制了解甚少，也很少将日常时间分配与直接测量的性别态度联系起来。本文利用TIMES观测站（TIMES Observatory）的数据填补了这一研究空白。该观测站针对艾米利亚-罗马涅（Emilia-Romagna）和坎帕尼亚（Campania）地区1,928对共同生活的夫妇进行了调查，这些夫妇至少有一名11岁以下的孩子。研究数据结合了夫妻双方在工作日和周末一天的日记记录，以及丰富的社会经济信息和关于性别规范的直接测量结果。我们得出了三个主要发现：首先，女性承担更多的无偿工作并花费更多时间照顾孩子，而男性则承担更多的有偿工作，并且在无孩子的情况下拥有更多的闲暇时间；其次，即使在双方都全职工作的夫妻中，这种性别差异依然显著，这意味着女性对劳动力市场的更高依附性本身并不能消除日常生活中的不平等现象；第三，更为传统的性别观念——尤其是在男性中——与男性在育儿和家务劳动中的参与度较低以及闲暇时间的分配差距...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Sandpile Economics: Theory, Identification, and Evidence
papers.abstract: Why do capitalist economies recurrently generate crises whose severity is disproportionate to the size of the triggering shock? This paper proposes a structural answer grounded in the evolutionary geometry of production networks. As economies evolve through specialization, integration, and competitive selection, their inter-sectoral linkages drift toward configurations of increasing geometric fragility, eventually crossing a threshold beyond which small disturbances generate disproportionately large cascades.   We introduce Sandpile Economics, a formal framework that interprets macroeconomic instability as an emergent property of disequilibrium production networks. The key state variable is the Forman--Ricci curvature of the input--output graph, capturing local substitution possibilities when supply chains are disrupted. We show that when curvature falls below an endogenous threshold, the distribution of cascade sizes follows a power law with tail index $α\in (1,2)$, implying a regime of unbounded amplification.   The underlying mechanism is evolutionary: specialization reduces input substitutability, pushing the economy toward criticality, while crisis episodes induce endogenous network reconfiguration and path dependence. These dynamics are inherently non-ergodic and cannot be captured by representative-agent frameworks.   Empirically, using global input--output data, we document that production networks operate in persistently negative curvature regimes and that curvature robustly predicts medium-run output dynamics. A one-standard-deviation increase in curvature is associated with higher cumulative growth over three-year horizons, and curvature systematically outperforms standard network metrics in explaining cross-country differences in resilience.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】为什么资本主义经济会反复出现危机，而这些危机的严重程度与引发危机的初始冲击相比不成比例？本文提出了一种基于生产网络演化几何结构的解释。随着经济通过专业化、整合和竞争性选择不断发展，各行业之间的联系逐渐变得更为脆弱，最终会突破一个临界点，使得微小的扰动能够引发大规模的连锁反应。我们提出了“沙堆经济学”（Sandpile Economics）这一理论框架，将宏观经济的不稳定性视为非均衡生产网络的一种涌现特性。该框架的核心状态变量是输入-输出图的Forman-Ricci曲率，该曲率反映了供应链中断时的局部替代可能性。研究发现，当曲率低于某个内生阈值时，危机规模的分布遵循幂律分布（尾指数α∈（1,2）），这意味着危机具有无限放大的特性。这种机制具有演化性质：专业化降低了投入品的替代性，使经济系统趋于临界状态；而危机事件则会导致网络结构的重新配置和路径依赖性。这些动态本质上是非遍历的（即无法通过传统代表性代理人模型来解释）。实证研究表明，全球范围内的生产网络普遍处于负曲率状态，且曲率能够有效预测中期的产出动态。曲率增加一个标准差与三年期内的更高累积增长率相关；此外，在解释各国经济韧性差异方...。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Higher-order ATM asymptotics for the CGMY model via the characteristic function
papers.abstract: Using only the characteristic function, we derive short-time at-the-money (ATM) call-price asymptotics for the exponential CGMY model with activity parameter $Y\in(1,2)$. The Lipton--Lewis formula expresses the normalized ATM call price, denoted $c(t,0)$, in terms of the characteristic exponent, which, upon rescaling at the rate $t^{-1/Y}$ from the $Y$-stable domain of attraction, yields $c(t,0) = d_{1} t^{1/Y} + d_{2} t + o(t)$ as $t\downarrow 0$. The first-order coefficient $d_{1}$ is the known stable limit from the domain of attraction of a symmetric $Y$-stable law, and $d_{2}$ is given by an explicit integral involving the characteristic exponent and the limiting stable exponent. We then extract closed-form higher-order coefficients by keeping the full Lipton--Lewis integrand intact and introducing a dynamic cutoff that partitions the domain into inner, core, and tail regions, establishing the expansion with controlled remainder. All coefficients are verified numerically against existing closed-form expressions where available.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】仅利用特征函数，我们推导出了具有活动参数 $Y\in(1,2)$ 的指数型 CGMY 模型在短时间内的平价（ATM）看涨期权价格渐近表达式。Lipton–Lewis 公式用特征指数表示标准化的平价看涨期权价格 $c(t,0)$，通过以 $t^{-1/Y}$ 的速率从 $Y$-稳定吸引域进行重新缩放，可得 $c(t,0) = d_{1} t^{1/Y} + d_{2} t + o(t)$（当 $t\downarrow 0$ 时）。一阶系数 $d_{1}$ 来自对称 $Y$-稳定分布的吸引域中的已知稳定极限，而 $d_{2}$ 则由涉及特征指数和极限稳定指数的显式积分给出。接下来，我们通过保留完整的 Lipton–Lewis 被积函数并引入一个动态截断机制（该机制将域划分为内部区域、核心区域和尾部区域），从而得到具有可控余项的展开式。所有系数均通过数值方法与现有的封闭形式表达式进行了验证（在可获取的情况下）。。

papers.title: Balanced Contributions in Networks and Games with Externalities
papers.abstract: For networks with externalities, where each component's worth may depend on the full network structure, balanced contributions and fairness lead to distinct component-efficient allocation rules. We characterize the unique component-efficient allocation rule satisfying balanced contributions -- the BCE rule. Existence is the main challenge: balanced contributions must hold on every edge, but the construction uses only spanning-tree edges. A cycle-sum identity bridges this gap by reducing balanced contributions on non-tree edges to relations in proper subnetworks. The BCE rule coincides with the Myerson value for TU games and with its generalization by Jackson--Wolinsky for network games without externalities, it recovers the externality-free value on the complete network, and -- unlike the fairness-based FCE rule -- it does not reduce to a graph-free formula applied to the graph-restricted game.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】对于存在外部性的网络而言，每个组件的价值可能取决于整个网络的结构。在这种情况下，平衡的贡献分配与公平性相结合，能够产生高效的组件分配规则。我们提出了一个满足平衡贡献要求的独特高效组件分配规则——即BCE规则。该规则的存在性是主要挑战：虽然平衡贡献需要在每条边上都得到满足，但算法的实现仅依赖于生成树的边。通过引入“循环和恒等式”（cycle-sum identity），该规则能够将非生成树边上的平衡贡献问题转化为相应子网络内的关系处理。BCE规则与Myerson值在具有交易不确定性（TU）的博弈中是一致的；同时，对于不存在外部性的网络博弈，该规则也与Jackson-Wolinsky提出的通用分配规则相吻合。此外，与基于公平性的FCE规则不同，BCE规则无需将问题简化为仅适用于图结构受限部分的公式即可得出最终结果。。
